notes.title: Devlog 34: ⛺ It takes a village
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/5332c51615e798d88ade6ab86f90601b12c4cd48.png[/img]

[b]Hello Pachans![/b]

April 25th is around the corner, and we’re so excited for you to play the game! 

Before diving into the amazing journey it’s been developing the game, here are a few important things to note.

[h2]❗Beta and Backer Keys❗[/h2]
As the release on April 25th is fast approaching, we’ve been working on the keys distribution website to ease the process of delivering them.

Now, you can manage your platforms at [url=https://rootsofpacha.com/orders]https://rootsofpacha.com/orders[/url]. You can switch platforms freely up until April 10th. On that day, the beta will end, we’ll invalidate all Steam beta keys and reissue Steam release keys. Any copies set to Steam will be locked for further changes. You’ll still be able to change copies from any console to Steam after April 10th, just keep in mind that if you do, you’ll be issued a Steam key and won’t be able to switch back to a console.

[h2]❗Release and Roadmap❗[/h2]
On April 25th, Roots of Pacha 1.0 will be released on Steam for Windows & Mac!

In the following sections, we will dive into all the work we’ve done to have a 40+ hour game. We’ll also call out the places where we’ve laid down the groundwork for future updates. We are committed to adding all the Kickstarter stretch goals and features that expand on the 1.0 end-game. 

After the game releases, we’ll first focus on making sure the game is stable and a bug-free experience. Then, we’ll begin the process of porting and testing the game on consoles. As this happens, we will be able to share what our expected roadmap is for the remaining content.

[h2]Player Character Customization[/h2]
We’ve added further customization options for your player character. You’ll be able to select one of 3 body types and pair it with one of 9 face options. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCharacter-selection.gif?alt=media[/img]

You will also be able to choose from 15 skin tones, 34 hairstyles and 30 colors, 10 styles of facial hair, and outfits to fully express your stone-age self.

[h2]Flora of Pacha[/h2]
There are more than 30 plants that grow natively in the regions of the world. Initially, you’ll need to discover where they grow and collect their seeds to plant them in your fields.

If you were a beta player, you’ll notice that wild plants will now only yield seeds. We made this change to better balance the game and make harvesting that much more rewarding.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-seeds.png?alt=media[/img]

As you keep planting them, you’ll gain knowledge that’ll change how the plant looks, reveal its growth cycle, and increase the value of its yield. You’ll also be able to propagate seeds when you discover the “Idea” of a plant nursery.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FBees.gif?alt=media[/img]

You’ll also discover “Ideas” that will change how you farm: a composter to create different kinds of plant food and soil improvements, a beehive to promote their symbiotic relationship with plants, and eventually, an irrigation system.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FIrrigation.png?alt=media[/img]

We’ve updated the irrigation system to fit better with advanced tools that affect 3, 6, or 9 tiles at a time. Now, the middle tile in between two irrigation trenches will also be watered.

[h2]Fauna of Pacha[/h2]
There are 7 tameable animals: Ibex, Ostrich, Wild Boar, Guanaco, Bison, Jungle Fowl, and Steppe Horse. Each with 10 variations to befriend and domesticate. On some days, you’ll find rare and even legendary variants hanging out with the herd.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-animals.png?alt=media[/img]

Once you tame these animals, they are your responsibility to feed and care for as they may get upset tummies, coughs, or fleas, and you’ll need to give them some medicine. 

Once you discover the “Idea” of animal breeding, you’ll be able to raise their stats and get higher-quality produce from your well-cared-for friends.

After the 1.0 release, we will introduce animal evolution, where you’ll breed animals to get more modern-day equivalents.

[h2]The Caves[/h2]
As you traverse the mysteries of the caves, you’ll gain new powers, discover new materials to craft with, develop new ideas, and evolve your tools.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCaves.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]The Lands & Neighboring Clans[/h2]
You’ll be able to explore the land you settled, the nearby forest, the depths of the caves, the expansive savanna, and the calm waters of the beach. Along the way, you’ll meet a few characters from two neighboring clans, the Yakuans of Turtle Islands and the Mograni of the Tundra. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCamp.png?alt=media[/img]

After the 1.0 release, players will be able to continue their stories and visit these areas. It’s also where we plan to introduce the Kickstarter stretch goals of camping, ball sport, the volcano cave, and fishing by boat.

[h2]Home Sweet Home[/h2]
You’ll be able to personalize your home with over 200 types of furniture and decorations. After you complete the “Idea” of an art station, it will unlock the ability to “paint” your own canvases and pottery to get even more creative with your space.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDeco.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Pets[/h2]
In the 1.0 release, you’ll find 5 different pets and can invite up to 3 to live with you in a fully upgraded house. You’ll be able to pet them and have them follow you. 

After the release, we plan on adding more interactions with your pets.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2Fbunny-pet.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Friendship[/h2]
Pachans love to dance, and with the right amount of friendship, they’ll dance with you too. It was important to us to create more ways to interact with the clan other than just gifting and talking. 

In the 1.0 release, there are a number of “world” cutscenes with non-romanceable characters that we felt helped tell the story of who the clan is. All players in co-op will experience these at the same time.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FAta-2F.png?alt=media[/img]

Romanceable characters also have 3 “personal” events (at 6, 8, and 10 flowers). Since we wanted you to experience all characters’ stories, the first 2 can be seen as either a hangout with a friend or as a date. 

In co-op, for the “personal” cutscenes, other players will go about their business as you’re whisked off to spend time with that character. Some of these events have different endings depending on what options you choose. 

After the 1.0 release, we’ll continue adding more cutscenes to help deepen the clan’s stories.

[h2]Romance[/h2]
You’ll be able to date 11 characters after seeing their 6 flowers cutscene. You can choose to date or not, which will influence the way you experience the 8 flower cutscene. The 10-flower cutscene is exclusively a date.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FNpc-actions.png?alt=media[/img]

There is no penalty for dating all romanceable characters at the same time, although you can only form a Union with one. Actions, like kissing, will unlock if you date an NPC long enough.

In the 1.0 release, you will be able to form a Union with any of the romanceable characters by the Pacha Tree. In a future update, you’ll be able to choose your union location. And if desired, break your Union.

[h2]Children[/h2]
Once you have a fully upgraded house and you’re in a Union, with either a character in the game or another player, you’ll be able to let Pacha know you’d like a child. With a little time, she will grant your wish, and a little one will appear. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FKid.png?alt=media[/img]

Cute as they are, infants are a lot of work and will need you to check in on them and take care of their needs throughout the day, or you’ll wake up tired from a poor night's sleep. The clan is there to help, but your child needs you too.

Once your little one is old enough, they’ll have their naming ceremony to become a toddler. As a toddler, you’ll experience new things, like teaching them to walk and start to talk.

After the 1.0 release, we plan to expand this and allow you to see your children grow into more life stages.

[h2]Pachan Festivals and Events[/h2]
The clan loves to appreciate the world around them and celebrates in:
[list]
[*] Cave Painting - paint your history on the cave walls
[*] Clan Gathering - submit the secret judge’s favorite dish
[*] Fall Carnival - compete in a music festival
[*] New Year's Eve -  ring in the new year watching the northern nights and hearing a story
[*] Competition Day - compete in a variety of mini-games to win prizes
[*] Winter Festival - chat with the clan and have a grand snowball fight
[*] Racing Days - Once you discover racing, you’ll be able to race twice a season against other characters
[/list]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FCompetition-day.png?alt=media[/img]

We want you to not feel rushed as you play, so are aiming to expand the number of festivals and possible activities (like the stretch goal “ball sport”) as we update the game and add the homeland of the Yakuans and Mograni.

[h2]Discoveries & Collections 🕵[/h2]
There are plenty of things to discover in Roots of Pacha.
[list]
[*] Explore the lands to find seeds or trade for some to grow over 30 types of plants in your fields.
[*] Develop 29 different ideas to change the way the clan lives.
[*] Cook over 70 unique recipes to become an experienced chef 🍝
[*] Catch over 40 species of fish in different spots and seasons 🐟
[*] Gather over 40 types of materials to craft or contribute around the land 🍅
[*] Increase your contribution by processing and preserving food in over 30 ways.
[*] Complete all the prophecies 🔥
[/list]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-recipes.png?alt=media[/img]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-fishes.png?alt=media[/img]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FDiscoveries-products.png?alt=media[/img]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F34%2FPyramid-prophecies-UI.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
We had a lot of fun coming up with over 50 achievements. For those that like achievement hunting, we hope you have fun with them!

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
Roots of Pacha is created from a place of love. When we look at the game, it’s easy for us to see each of the team's contributions to the whole. Like Pachans, we worked together to create something bigger than ourselves and went on a journey that was new for us all. 

We say it every devlog, but it feels even more important for this one, thank you. Thank you for going on this journey with us. Thank you to the backers who helped fund this project. Thank you to those that supported us and helped spread the word of Pacha. And thank you to the community for all your kindness.

Thank you all for your support. We can’t wait to hear all of your feedback on the release.
You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 31: 🎊 Happy RoP Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/0965341f675a66d32d5424b2573fdbfca2776870.png[/img]

Hello Pachans! 
 
✨We hope you're having a great start to the year.✨

Let’s ring in the New Year, the year of Roots of Pacha, by sharing some of our latest developments. In this Devlog, we’ll focus on new decor and art portraits. 

As we mentioned in our previous devlog, our updates leading up to release may seem smaller than usual. We want some of Pacha’s mysteries to be revealed only when it’s time.

[h2]Cozy Beginnings [/h2]
To start the year with some cozy vibes we put some of the winter soundtrack on YouTube for your listening pleasure.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kGigXB7eilI&ab_channel=RootsofPacha][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F31%2FWinter%20Vibes%20Thumbnail.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

[h2]Home Sweet Home [/h2]
Your home is becoming cozier and cozier. We’ve added more decor to the game so that you can take your customization further and truly make your space unique. 

Some of these new decorations include pots and fillers to brighten up your home. You can place these items on furniture around your home.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F31%2FPots1.png?alt=media[/img]

We’ve also added new rug varieties for you to combine and design your spaces. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F31%2FRugs.png?alt=media[/img]

Furniture is, of course, one of the most important pieces in any given space. Add a touch of elegance with gilded chairs or keep things rustic with simple wood-carved designs. Some items only become available after completing certain Ideas, such as “The Toolstation” and discovering how to work with obsidian.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F31%2FFerniture.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Animals [/h2]
Animals have been our friends for a while in Roots of Pacha. We care for them and, in return,  they share their produce with us. Animal variants have been added to the game, as well as a stats system and breeding mechanics.

We’ve already invited baby mammoths into our homes, and now we’ve added a few new animal species that have us howling. You’ll find these baby beasts in various parts of the world where you’ll work to gain their trust. [h2]Future Devlogs [/h2]

To balance being informative and leaving some surprises for you, we’ll do our best to continue keeping you informed without going into too much detail.

notes.title: Devlog 27: 🏖 The summer competition festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/eda889f955b12acc57fab41dbf7ef6c694da16d5.png[/img]

Hello Pachans! Another month of hard work has passed. We’ve continued to expand NPC animations, portraits, and their stories. Now, in this devlog, we will focus on a brand new festival and the expanded caves. 

[h2]Update on Release [/h2]
We have decided to move Roots of Pacha’s release to early 2023.  We have aimed to be as transparent as possible and need more time to deliver the experience we promised and the one we all dreamed of playing.

Game development is an iterative process with many interconnected systems that all need time and energy dedicated to them. The team is comprised of talented individuals who have both met and exceeded expectations regarding the alpha, beta, and demo. We are incredibly proud of these accomplishments so far.

With that said, even with a talented team and the “quick pace” we’re working at, we unfortunately lacked the experience to gauge how much time it would take to create the game we promised you all. To achieve the level of quality we want and that you all expect and deserve, we would rather take the necessary time to deliver. We’re confident it will be worth the wait. We may not have made our 2022 projection, but we aren’t far off either. We can see the finish line and need a little more time before we can give you an exact release date. We’re looking to announce a final release date in December.

We will continue to post devlogs to keep you updated on our progress as we take transparency very seriously. Our goal is to be as honest and forthcoming as we can with you. 

For our Kickstarter Backers, we are forever grateful that you chose to support the development of the game that allowed us to grow our team and make our collective dream a reality. So, as a token of our never-ending gratitude, we’d like to ease the wait a little by inviting you to join the Beta. To receive your Steam Key, just enter the email you backed with here (https://rootsofpacha.com/orders/) and a key will be sent to you.

Pachans are ready for some summer fun at the Beach! We added a competition festival to the clan's calendar so you can have tons of fun with the community’s minigames.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F27%2FSpears.gif?alt=media[/img]

Once you complete Monkey and Bear’s challenges, you’ll use their powers to find passageways with Monkey's leaps of faith or muscle your way through obstacles using Bear’s strength.

On your way to the cave's completion, you’ll find hidden rooms and other mysteries along the way.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F27%2FWater.gif?alt=media[/img]

Thank you for following our development journey with your continued support! The team is truly grateful for it. Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: Devlog 25: 🏠 A new way back home
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/6e47ecbc122117e7b10c1a0fdd34f5a4a4f4adeb.jpg[/img]

We had a pretty amazing June! We started off with [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RFO4BJbdpPg&t=8785s] Day of the Devs [/url] and the associated Play Days event, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLDFJSQ6EVM] IGN Summer of Gaming [/url], Steam Next Fest, and releasing a demo alongside it all. Seeing our work in the limelight has been an unbelievable experience, but nothing can top the amount of love we’ve received from people playing the demo.

With so many players, we’ve received helpful feedback that we’re incorporating into the game. Some examples include a way to return from the top of the Forest mountain without retracing your steps, increasing options in the character creator, and more!

One of the incredibly exciting parts has been seeing our community grow. We grew so much this month that all 5 fires were lit in the Discord mini-game! 

[h2] Cutscenes [/h2]
We’ve been busy creating storylines, music, and animations to bring another layer of depth to the game. In this last month, we’ve given a little extra attention to Illoe and Garrek. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2Filloe-Gif 2.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h2] New Processors [/h2]
The clan has more Ideas in the works such as a pickler, vinegar maker, brewer, and cask. You’ll be able to process your crops into something that lasts a little longer and is more valuable to the clan when you contribute it. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FProcessors.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h2] Map Redesigns [/h2]
We already had a beautiful waterfall in place, so it seemed like a fun idea to be able to go behind it. Now, players will be able to find their way back home by taking a shortcut to the bottom of the hill. So those late-night trips back from the caves should be a little less stressful.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FForestshortcut.png?alt=media[/img]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F25%2FSavanna-03.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2] The Future [/h2]
With the knowledge gained from our Beta and the demo shortly thereafter, we plan to go full “nose to the grindstone” (while of course maintaining a healthy life for the team) in these upcoming months and focus on what is essential to get us to a solid 1.0 release. Our future devlogs will likely be sparse compared to our usual updates or include [redacted]s so that we can avoid spoiling too much.

As always thank you for your support.

[b]You rock![/b]

The more detailed mini-map will help you find your way. There are icons for the animals and plants you’ve found. The list of people also now gives you more info on each character, like their in world sprite, if they have an idea, and if you can exchange with them like Jizu, the clothing maker.

The demo will have a shortened version of the game intro that explains why you moved to this new land.

[h3]New People to Exchange With[/h3]
You can now exchange with Grob for meat and other animal products. For now, it can be smoked and dried, but it will be a part of recipes you can cook. In the future, there will be vegetarian substitutes for the recipes that require meat.

You can get a fabulous new hat from Jizu, the clothing maker. In the future, she will have other outfits you can exchange for as well!

notes.title: Devlog 22: 🌄 Pacha calls
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]


Hello Pachans!! This is a mammoth-and-a-half-sized 🐘 update for the game! We’ve added irrigation, expanded caves, romance and dating, a complete overhaul to the ui, new character portraits, and more! (more info on those in devlog #19, #20, #21). In this devlog, we cover a few new ideas, trading, animal updates like racing, and a whole lot more listed at the bottom of the devlog. 

We can’t wait for Be-ta Backers to play (and send their feedback too!). For those anxiously waiting the game, we’ll have a demo in June we hope you’ll enjoy. 🔥🔥🔥

There’s still a “road to be walked,” with lots of content to develop, but we’re more than happy with the state of the game right now. To celebrate, we’ll be doing a [url=https://youtu.be/7snMSbjXJI8]live stream[/url] with [u]SharkyGames[/u] [b]on Tuesday, April 12th at 10 am PDT[/b] on YouTube 🥳🥳 Hope to see you there!

[h2]The Ideas of Ideas[/h2]

"Ideas" are one of the most important aspects of the game. We implemented and tested a few processors in the Alpha that are now "Ideas" in the Beta. For example, you'll help Tare develop a Press that helps the clan juice more things.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FTinWaterBucket.gif?alt=media[/img]

Once you explore deep into the caves, you'll find tin that will spark an "Idea" on how to work with this new material. From there, you'll be able to upgrade your sickle and make a tin bucket that holds more water.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FIrrigation.gif?alt=media[/img]


Make watering your crops even quicker by developing the Idea of irrigation with Garrek. After he sees you using your new tin watering can, he will have an idea he would like to discuss with you. 

[h2]Trading[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FZelkArrives.png?alt=media[/img]

Our Pachan friend, Zelk, returns to the clan along with his partner, Nari, and their daughter Era, who have never met the clan before. Through Zelk, we'll get the "Idea" to trade with others, giving us the ability to get resources that are harder to find.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FTrading.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Social[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FIbonChat.png?alt=media[/img]

We need each other to not only survive, but to thrive. In this update, we implemented more of the social side, which was many, many months in the making.

[h3]Dialogues[/h3]

All characters now have a minimum of ten dialogues. The two romanceable characters in Beta Frer and Mana have over 50 and 40 dialogues, respectively. We feel this is a good "first coat of paint" on the social system and something we look forward to expanding upon for release. 

[h3]Gifts[/h3]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FGift.png?alt=media[/img]

All characters have a set of loved, liked, disliked, and hated gifts that will affect your friendship with them with unique dialogue associated. You can also get an extra boost to friendship if you give them a gift on their birthday, especially a loved gift.

[h2]A Few New Looks[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FNewReese.png?alt=media[/img]

While redesigning the portraits, we gave a few characters a fresh look in the world that better fit their personalities and added to our cast.

[h2]New Place To Get Things[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FReeseShop.png?alt=media[/img]

Decorate with things that Reese made. Visit her and find what items will help you turn your hut a home. 

She will also have some extra fabric that will allow you to expand your belt and carry more items as you travel the land.

[h2]Animals[/h2]

[h3]Racing[/h3]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FRace.gif?alt=media[/img]

In the Alpha, we could only race with others in multiplayer. Now, you'll be able to race Mana and Jelrod every Saturday. It also will become part of clan culture and something near and dear to some of the characters. We look forward to telling you more about this as we expand this Idea.

[h3]Animal Updates[/h3]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FGuanacos.png?alt=media[/img]

We had a few animals with color variations in the game, but we thought it was time for guanacos and bison (who are now rideable) to get some new styles. You can also gather fur from boars by shearing them.

[h3]Improved Mini-Game[/h3]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FAnimalGame.gif?alt=media[/img]

Like fishing before it, we felt it was time to give this game a little more polish. To attune to an animal, you will play the game until you fill all the notes. It may take you one try or a few. Some animals will be harder to tame than others.


[h2]The Lore Expands[/h2]

The story is something we don't want to spoil for those who wish to discover it for themselves, so we'll remain tight-lipped on many parts. So instead, we will tell you the question we hope to answer: what brought us to the Land Between Two Rivers?

Caves have been a spiritual place throughout human history and we aim to honor that legacy with a thoughtful experience and a dash of humor. We hope you'll enjoy the adventure.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

We now have full controller support! This not only offers us a better experience now, but it will help us when we develop for consoles later.

We now have an easier-to-navigate UI. This was a massive undertaking that took a lot of time and attention. You can read more about it in devlog 21.

We’ll have a Mac OS build in the near future. So our alpha and beta backers who prefer to play on mac should have access soon.

[h2]Mark Your Calendars![/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F22%2FStreaming.gif?alt=media[/img]

After a busy few months, we wanted to hang out with the community again, so we’ll start a new save and stream the game on Tuesday, April 12th at 10 am PDT on [url=https://youtu.be/7snMSbjXJI8]YouTube[/url]. Plus, we’ll be raffling a few Beta Keys! We hope to see you in chat!

We’ve mentioned it a few times in the Discord, but we are excited to announce we will have a demo on Steam in June. We can’t wait for people to play! Stay tuned for more info.

[h2]Added Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Revamped UI
[*] Full controller support
[*] New portraits
[*] New game intro and initial quests
[*] New introduction to the Yakuan and Mograni clans

[*] Host won't get kicked if the internet is lost

[*] Steam Cloud saves
[/list]




[b]You rock![/b]
-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 21: 🎨 You and I
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]

[b]Hello Pachans![/b] With only one month left of development until the Beta milestone, lots has been done in Roots of Pacha and there’s still more to come. In this devlog, we’ll focus on two big changes: the intro to the game and the new UI.

[h2]New Beginnings[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FNewIntro.png?alt=media[/img]

With Beta backers gaining access to the game in a month, we thought now would be a great time to focus on and test out how players are introduced to the game. We wanted to create something that wasn’t overwhelming for new players yet not too intrusive for those familiar with the genre.

In the stone age, ideas were passed on through stories and art. On day one, Igrork will introduce you to the concept of farming and you’ll receive your first cave-art tutorial on how to farm. If you are familiar with the game or the genre, these “pop-ups” are easy to close and will be something that people can revisit later in a future update.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FYakuansVisit.png?alt=media[/img]

After this initial tutorial, other timed events will follow, like introducing other ideas, the opening of the caves, beach, and savanna. Spreading out these events allowed us to tie them more closely to the story of the world without intruding too much on how the player spends their time.

The game will also have its first “quests” introduced that will reward you once you complete them. 

The story of how you arrived to Pacha's lands will be further integrated into the early stages of the game, but the full story will be told at the game’s launch.


[h2]New UI[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FMenu.gif?alt=media[/img]

Great UI helps with accessibility and clarity, so this is something we’ve given a lot of attention to over the past few months with a complete overhaul. The new look and improved functionality will help us lay the groundwork for future integration with controllers and consoles later.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FIlloeChat.png?alt=media[/img]
 
This new style gave us a chance to spruce up the characters’ portraits. We loved the previous art, but this new look is far more expressive and a direction we’re excited to continue.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F21%2FFriendUi.gif?alt=media[/img]

With the new UI, you’ll be able to track your friendship status and what gifts they liked (or didn’t) and see when their birthdays are.


Thank you for your continued support. We’re just making a game about community and the importance of kindness, but we can’t help but hope life would imitate art a little more. Stay safe out there. If you can, we’d appreciate it if you did one extra kind act like buying coffee for the person behind you in line, donating to a worthy charity, or picking up litter. The little things add up. The world needs it right now. 🧡


[b]You rock![/b]

notes.title: Devlog 20: 💖 A Deeper Meaning
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]

[b]Hello, Pachans![/b] Love is in the air and the clan is feeling it too. In this devlog, we’ll focus on two aspects of the April 8th update: romance and caves.

[h2]Depths of the Heart[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FReception.gif?alt=media[/img]

Although Pachans don’t celebrate Valentine's Day, they’ve been in a romantic mood lately. In the next update, you’ll be able to date and form a union with Frer, Mana, and two other characters.

In an earlier update, Frer had 2 “world” cutscenes added to the game that told a little bit of his story. The upcoming build will have 3 additional “personal events.”

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FManaDate.png?alt=media[/img]

What’s the difference between “world” and “personal” events you say? Glad you asked! 
World events are triggered by going to a specific location between certain times and will include all players, if playing in multiplayer. These types of events often carry over into the dialogue and daily routines affecting the world as well. 

A “personal event” is player-initiated through dialogue and includes only that character and the person who initiated it. If playing in multiplayer, everyone else will go about their business as usual. These events are more like “dates” or hanging out with a friend, in some cases. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FKiss.gif?alt=media[/img]

Once you gain enough flowers with Mana, Frer, or one of the other dateable characters, you’ll be able to pursue a relationship with that special someone and give them a kiss for a small boost in your relationship.

Once you reach 10 flowers, you can form a union! A union consists of a short ceremony with a reception following right after.  At the reception, you’ll be able to walk around in your union attire and chat with guests before heading back to the village with your new partner in life.

This will continue to be expanded on beyond what will be in the next interaction of the build. We want your partner to be a meaningful part of your life and continue to have a life of their own as well.



[h2]Depths of the Soul[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F20%2FCaves_Surprised.gif?alt=media[/img]

You’ll cross into the edges of the spirit world in the forest cave. There, you’ll meet some totem guides that will help you through its mysterious depths. 

Throughout the cave you’ll find challenges to test your ability to observe the world around you. This iteration of the caves is just the beginning with more totems and puzzles planned for the future.


[h2]Depths of Gratitude[/h2]

February 22nd is the one year mark from when we first launched the Kickstarter. It’s been beyond a dream come true. Because of all the backers and the support of the community as a whole, this game will be something even better than what we first imagined. 

Over the last month, there’s been a resurgence of attention for our little game thanks to one of our artists posting on Reddit and an article on PC Gamer. To all those who have been around since Kickstarter or before, we hope you join us in welcoming the new folks to our community. The fact that so many people are interested in a game centered around discovery and kindness is truly inspiring. 


You rock!
The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 19: 💧 Fresh Waters
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]

[b]Hello Pachans! [/b]

We’d like to wish you all a Happy New Year! Let 2022 bring you plenty of warmth, bright moments, and happy memories. 2021 was an amazing year for us, full of surprises, events, and unwavering support from our community. To our Kickstarter supporters specifically, thank you for believing in us from the start, spreading the word, and giving us a chance to fulfill our dream. We quickly smashed the initial goal and ended up 1,115% funded! 

It was a wild ride, hitting stretch goal after stretch goal, with many happy tears shed. 

Following the Kickstarter, we were able to achieve another enormous milestone: a playable Alpha. Since then, we’ve released 6 major Alpha updates, each containing new game mechanics, overhauls, and polish. 

Your feedback has helped us improve Roots of Pacha and shape the game to become the best possible experience for players. As we continue to work on the game, please keep it up! We’re paying attention to everything you have to say. 

At the end of 2021, we spent time scheduling things for next year and evaluating the team’s progress. Here are our plans for 2022: 

[h2]Our next update will be Beta[/h2]

Those who pledged at the Beta level will get access to the game on April 8, 2022! This will be a huge milestone for us and we can’t wait for more players to try out the early version of the game. This date gives us an extra month in our development cycle so that we can polish this juicy update.

[h3]New Ideas[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FIrrigation.gif?alt=media[/img]

As ideas shape our world, they continue to do so in Roots of Pacha. New Ideas like Hammering, Trading, and Irrigation will find their way into the Beta. 

[h3]Item Placement[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FPlacingItems.gif?alt=media[/img]

Make your decorative mark on the village and place items where you’d like. Players will no longer be limited to placing items in the fields.

[h3]Dating and Marriage[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FUnion.gif?alt=media[/img]

Eyeing that special someone? We will add 4 datable characters with which you can eventually form a union. Each character will have their own series of cutscenes, so you can get to know them a little better. Their dialogues will be expanded following the Beta, but we can't wait for you to learn more about our first 4 datables.

[h3]Polish[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F19%2FMinimap.gif?alt=media[/img]

Our mini-map reflects the village you create (including your crops), so it felt only natural to have it reflect the season as well. 

We’ve been working on adding a new layer of polish to the game with new UI and updated character portraits.

[h3]And More[/h3]
We’ll expand on these and other updates in the future as we continue to do our monthly devlogs. So stay tuned for more. 🔥

If you still haven’t joined our Discord, be sure to do so. We have alpha/beta key giveaways, mini-games, and much more to discover! 

[url=https://bit.ly/RoP-SteamDiscord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img][/url]


[h2]Release[/h2]
After taking a hard look at what we wanted in our 1.0 release, and considering the increased scope that came with Kickstarter, we realized we need more time than our initial projection of Q2 of 2022. Our current plan is to release in late 2022.

This was not a decision we made lightly, as we strived to find the right balance of getting the game into your hands as soon as possible and how much content can be made to create a complete experience. 

We take pride in our game, story, and community. Even if we too wished we could release sooner, we feel that given a little extra time, we can offer a more polished and meaningful experience - one that is worthy of you, who make this all possible.

We believe the future of this game is brighter than ever. The community centered around a game about kindness and cooperation has only grown. The team has only gotten stronger, and the dream of two brothers has become so much more.

You Rock.

-The Soda Den Team

Happy Holidays Pachans! We couldn’t think of a better way to wrap up the year than with a New Years Festival and live stream. We hope you were able to join us, but if you couldn’t, here’s a link if you’d like to check it out. Otherwise, we hope you enjoy the summary below. 

[previewyoutube=IxphJ6uTikU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thanks for being such an awesome and supportive community. We look forward to seeing what 2022 brings!


[h2]New Years Festival[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FFestivalStory.gif?alt=media[/img]

Join the clan for a New Year’s festival at the mountain summit. You’ll chat with the characters to hear many of their wishes for the upcoming year, listen to a story about how the northern lights came to be, and watch the lights in action.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FLights.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h2]The Great Connector[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FCrossBridgeImage.png?alt=media[/img]

Vuak has a vision that there’s something you need to see on the other side of the river. You’ll have to gather supplies from far outside the land, but once you do, you’ll be rewarded with the start of a grand challenge that will continue at release.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FMeetOwl.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Player House Upgrades[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FPlayerHouseUpgrade.gif?alt=media[/img]

You’ll be working hard and might want a little extra room to stretch your legs (or invite that special someone to come live with you). Once you get enough materials and contribution points you’ll be able to upgrade your house and your kitchen as well! Having an upgraded kitchen (and the utensils that are being developed to go along with it) will expand the possibilities of the dishes you can make.


[h2]Everyday Life[/h2]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2Fwoodchop.gif?alt=media[/img]

We continuously add layers of detail as we develop the “big” things in the game. As you explore the world, you’ll find the characters going about their business, which mostly includes helping the clan like Jag is. He looks after the village by making sure there’s always a fire ready to warm your hands or cook with.

As you venture around the world and experience the different seasons, you’ll hear music and ambient sounds that shape the world. We hope you enjoy all the hard work and love that has gone into creating this experience. 

We’ve also put another coat of paint on the characters’ likes and dislikes. This will continue to evolve as we add more things to the game, but each character now has a neutral, dislike, like, hate, and love response for gifts and a couple of items for each.

The interior of characters’ homes are also being designed to reflect their unique personalities and roles in the clan. Tetih is the oldest member of the clan who enjoys the “finer” things in stone age life, like decorative rugs and a big cozy bed.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F18%2FTetihChat.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Building for the Future[/h2]

It’s exciting to be working on aspects of the game that don’t fit nicely into one “sprint” or “devlog cycle.” These are the parts of the game that will weave the world into something greater than the sum of its parts.

Love is an important part of the human experience and our history. It’s important to us that it’s meaningful in Roots of Pacha. So we’ve been working hard to create a story for each character you can date and the system surrounding how you go about seeing that special someone.

We’re also working on stories and cutscenes with other people in the clan as well as the deeper meaning of what Pacha has in store for us. A lot of this work won’t be reflected in the alpha as it’s still being developed.


[b]Until Next Time [/b]💖

Thanks for taking the time to read what we’ve been up to. We hope you and yours have a happy and safe holiday. You rock!

-The Soda Den Team

notes.title: Devlog 17: ⭐ Reach For The Stars
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]
Hello Pachans! We’re back with another mid-sprint devlog! We say it every time, but we continue to make huge strides in the Roots of Pacha world. Progress has been made with character activities and their homes, the main story, a winter festival, and so much more! We hope you enjoy reading about what we’ve been up to.

[h3]Character Homes & Activities[/h3]
The clan was getting cold from the last wintery update, so they wanted to get cozy inside. This sprint we’re working on updated interiors for some of the NPCs. Each home in the clan will reflect its unique inhabitants. Can you guess who calls this house home?

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FHouse_Interior.png?alt=media[/img]

The clan has many chores they need to do throughout the day. You’ll find various characters going about their business with their new animations.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FIgrork-Sweeping.gif?alt=media[/img]

[h3]A Greater Calling[/h3]
After completing a quest that takes you to the Jungle, you will find a mysterious pyramid topped with four totems. Through this structure, you will progress through the larger story by completing different “quests” and learn why you were destined to live in the Land Between Two Rivers. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FJungle-Pyramid-WIP.gif?alt=media[/img]

If you’ve seen our Kickstarter trailer, you know it ended with a pyramid. This pyramid will be added to the game, although in a different form. We loved the original style of the pyramid, but when we started to work with it in the game, its style felt out of place in the more organic world of Pacha. So we reworked it to fit within the world and the story we’re telling.

[h3]A New Year[/h3]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F17%2FWinter festival.png?alt=media[/img]

The end of winter signals the coming of new life. You will join the clan as they say goodbye to the chill of winter and welcome spring. You will travel to the top of the snow-covered mountain where you will make “wishes” for the coming year, tell stories, and watch the lights of Quro dance in the sky. 

[h3]House Upgrades[/h3]
You’ve been working hard gathering and planting, so we felt it was time that you’re able to upgrade your home. Expanding your house will allow you to form a union with your special someone and have them move in. Then eventually have children join your hearth.

Those who love cooking will be able to expand their repertoire of dishes with new appliances and utensils that are unlocked at each stage. Then you’ll be able to make your friends the meals they love.

[h3]Love & Marriage[/h3]
We started adding cutscenes last alpha update, and work has continued on how you can woo that eligible single who catches your eye. We want to make sure that your union feels meaningful to both you and the character.

[h3]Switch Progress & Unity 2021[/h3]
Like Pachans preparing for winter, we know how important it is to prepare for the long term. Lots of progress has been made with optimizations, the save system, joystick support, and cross-platform play with Switch. We also upgraded the project to Unity 2021 early, which has allowed us to take advantage of some of the new features as we optimize and keep our “tech debt” low.

[h3]Epic[/h3]
We’re excited to say that Roots of Pacha will be available on the Epic store as well as Steam when we release next year. We’re excited that even more people will be able to play our game. 

Thanks for sticking with us through this journey. Your excitement and continued support mean the world to us. If you haven’t already, we hope you join the community in Discord.

Leave a comment with whose house you think is included in this devlog and why. 💖

notes.title: Devlog #16: 🐟 Knifetooth
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]
Hello, clan! We’ve just completed another development cycle and big strides have been made in the Pachan culture and the world as a whole. We have a full four seasons, an updated fishing mini-game, a new idea, two new other clans, and big changes in how the characters interact with you and the world.

[h3]Winter[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FWinter.gif?alt=media[/img]
It’s time to gather around the fire as snowflakes are falling in the Land Between Two Rivers. You will now be able to experience winter and cycle through an entire year! Each season will continue to be improved, but we’re excited to have reached this milestone!

A few new chill-resistant plants, gatherables, fish, and seasonal music can be found while exploring the land.

[h3]Social[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FGins.gif?alt=media[/img]
We’ve started to give the social aspect of Roots of Pacha a lot more development focus. We added summer and raining schedules, dialogues, and animations to breathe a little more life into the characters' daily routines. 

On rainy and snowy days the clan will hunker down inside, but their activities won't stop. You’ll be able to see Pachans hanging out at the Pacha Hearth or at each other's homes. In this development cycle, we added Gin and Tare’s home interior and made it accessible within the alpha. Their home has a little extra grandeur to it from their status within the clan, but they’re still welcoming to their fellow Pachans.

[h3]Friendship[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDance.gif?alt=media[/img]

Like other farming sims, you’ll be able to talk with and give gifts to NPCs to improve friendship, but true to the culture of the world, dance will also help you connect with characters. But a character won’t want to dance with you right away so you will need to raise your friendship to a point where they’re happy to bust a move with you. You’ll be able to check your friendship status (represented by flowers) in the Journal and see who you’ve given gifts, danced with, and spoken to.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FFriendUi.gif?alt=media[/img]

Once you gain enough friendship you will be able to see world-changing events for some characters. We feel it's important that your actions, including your friendships, change the lives of the characters around you. They may start going outside the Land or spending time with other characters. 

We have many cutscenes in the works but we started with Frer’s first two. Alpha players will be able to see them at two and four flowers. Since we’re developing for single and multiplayer, these two cutscenes can be experienced by all players at the same time. After these two cutscenes are experienced, Frer’s schedule will change slightly to reflect his character development. We’re excited to expand on this direction in storytelling.

We gave a few characters a makeover. After our Gamescom Festival, we wanted to give Ibon and Jelrod a look that better reflected the divas that they are.

To create the living breathing world we have a lot more cutscenes, schedules, dialogue, animations, and characters to add. But we’re pretty happy with the strides we’ve made these past two months.

[h3]Roaming Clans[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FMograni.png?alt=media[/img]
We’ve started working on two other roaming clans, the Mograni and the Yakuans. These groups seem to be the opposite in almost every way. One lives in the cold North while the other makes the Turtle Islands home. No one remembers what started this feud but the clans have little to no kind words to spare for each other. Thankfully for them, Pacha gave our clan a sign to settle between them. Could this be a part of a larger plan?

Three characters from each clan have been added to the alpha with a few dialogues each.  It’s been exciting to see the early stages of this story take shape and we’re looking forward to expanding on it.

[h3]Fishing[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FFishing.gif?alt=media[/img]
Like Pachans we strive to better our ideas and our fishing mini-game is one of them. After getting player feedback and testing it ourselves we felt it needed an update. We decided to change the way the hover works and more clearly indicate where you needed to keep your cursor within. From there, an indicator will fill up to 4 bars when it's time to strike. We also changed how the fish became aware of you. Once they see you you have a short time to move the cursor away and wait for them to go back to not noticing you before resuming your progress in catching the fish.

[h3]A New Idea[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FYakuans.png?alt=media[/img]
Although Pachans are innately inventive, they’re not the only ones with Ideas. Yakuans and Mogranis have their own way of doing things and have been mastering their surroundings for years. Once they trust you enough, they’ll share their way of living with you and maybe you’ll even invent something together.

[h3]Discord bot[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F16%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img]
Starting in October, instead of having alpha raffles based on the top players of our Discord minigame, everyone will be able to earn “tickets” 🎟️ based on their own achievements. 

The clan works together to unlock “fires” that will translate into the number of alpha raffles we do at the end of the month. We start with 2 fires (raffles) and each additional one is unlocked based on everyone’s total contribution. 

If you haven’t already, join us now for a chance to win, and hangout with the awesome community. You don’t want to miss the new #🎈-wholesome-memes channel! 💖😂🦆

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

[h3]What’s next[/h3]
We’ll work to expand on the social aspect like dating and marriage, add new ideas like irrigation, and continue to weave the threads that tie the world together.

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/signup][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FMailing.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #14: The power of rocks! ⛏
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]

Hello Clan! Summer brought many new plants to our Clan, and our old tools could barely keep up. Acre, Igrork, and Ata have a few Ideas on how to improve things.

[h2]Plant Knowledge
[/h2]It all starts with a seed, a tiny powerhouse that provides for the clan. There are no stores, and traders are too infrequent to get these all-important parts of farming life. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FWildAndDomesticatedCropped.png?alt=media[/img]

When you return from the wilderness with a seed, it will first grow as it did in its wild form. As you tend to the plant, the Clan will gain “Knowledge” about its needs. This will change how the plant looks, and it will start bearing a domesticated version of the original wild yield. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FTomato.png?alt=media[/img]

The more we sow and harvest a plant, the more Knowledge we’ll accumulate. Once a plant is domesticated, its yield quality will improve as it’s tended. This quality will affect contribution, refill rates of stamina, and even how much a Clan member will like that item.

[h2]Plant Nursery[/h2]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FNursery_Sketch_Black.gif?alt=media[/img]

It has always been our adoptive grandad’s dream to tend to plants and, although he is too old now to till the soil, he wants to help. Once you reach a specific Knowledge of plants, he’ll come up with the idea to create a “Plant Nursery.” There, Igrork can help by tending to the plants and providing a new source to get seeds rather than out in the wild.

[h2]Tools[/h2]
The hands of our Clan have accomplished a lot, but it was their innovation of tools that allowed them to do more.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FObsidian_Sketch_Black.gif?alt=media[/img]

After you find obsidian for the first time, Acre will have the Idea to build a workstation that will allow her to work with these new-found materials. With the necessary resources, you will be able to improve your tools from flint to obsidian, tin, copper, and even to materials that require smelting.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FHoe.png?alt=media[/img]

Ata, the ambitious kid with a Hammer as a sidekick, will have the idea to start smelting metal. With her and her parents' help (she’s little after all), the Workstation will be improved to accommodate her wild idea to make metal stronger by mixing it.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FSickleHarvest.gif?alt=media[/img]
These upgrades will allow you to accomplish more with less effort. 

[h2]Bot[/h2]
Cooperation is important to us, that’s why it plays such a pivotal role in Roots of Pacha. Our intention with the Discord bot is to have something fun that reflects that and brings everyone in the server together.

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

Starting July, instead of giving the alpha keys to the top 2 contributors, we’ll raffle 2 keys within the Top 15 contributors. But that’s not all, we’re also bringing back the community goals to increase the number of alpha keys raffled. Depending on how much contribution we all make as a Clan, we’ll raffle up to 5 alpha keys per month, the first 3 among the Top 15 and the last 2 among the Top 50.

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F14%2FFourFires.png?alt=media[/img][/url]
[i]A 3rd alpha raffle has already been unlocked !! 🔥🔥🔥[/i]

We just started working on updates to the bot. We’ll begin with mini-quests for the whole Clan, which will unlock new plants, a hummus item to save for whenever you’re hungry and need more stamina, random campfires for you to rest at, increased max stamina for a limited time, and new emojis for the server.

[h2]Coming up[/h2]
Some other things that are in the works for the next update:

[h3]A New Season[/h3]
The leaves are changing, and the air is getting crisper. Fall brings with it lots of exciting visual changes as well as a toe-tapping festival for all to enjoy. 

[h3]The Beach[/h3]
Fall is coming to the Land Between Two Rivers, but it’s still warm by the beach. We’ll be able to explore the area and find new plants and fish.

The next month’s edition will be a stream showing off this mammoth-sized alpha update. Stay tuned! You rock!

notes.title: Devlog #13: Guanaco 🦙
notes.content:
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F13%2FDevlogBodyHeader.png?alt=media[/img]
Hello Clan! Following our update cycle, today we’re releasing a new alpha version: 0.3.0 Guanaco. 

Thanks to everyone who joined us in the livestream where we showcased many of the new features and content. We added a new area 🌾, a new season ☀, expanded the processors 🧀, added plants 🍆, animals 🐃, & more! 

[previewyoutube=iZDLPvh2e6c;full][/previewyoutube]

With so much new content we couldn’t start at the beginning, so we’ll tell you a bit about a new event, The Rite of Passage.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F13%2FRite%20Start.png?alt=media[/img]

The Clan’s success depends on every adult being a contributing member to society. So the passage from adolescence to adulthood is something to be celebrated. As a new adult, you go through this rite on the 7th day, taking an oath and learning about your guardian spirit.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F13%2FRite%20End.png?alt=media[/img]

[h3]What’s next[/h3]
We’ve got many features and content planned for the next alpha iteration, which releases in early August. Next up we’re adding the Fall season and beach region. We also plan to give extra attention to animals by starting work on the “pets” mechanic and making tamed animals go in/out of sheds.

Stay tuned next month for the mid-cycle devlog with more insight on these and more content!

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #12: A new season begins ☀
notes.content:
Hi Clan! It’s devlog time, and we’re starting to feel the summer vibes. 🌴 Here’s what we’ve been up to 🔥.

[h2]Surveys and rewards[/h2]
All surveys have been sent to backers, and we’re at over 90% completion. If you still haven’t gotten the invite to PledgeBox or have any questions about your survey, please email us at support@rootsofpacha.com or message @creb or @berkza on Discord. 

We’re organizing the production and distribution of physical and digital rewards. They’ll be sent in batches closer to release, and we’ll update their status in the devlogs.

[h2]New team members[/h2]
We also wanted to tell you that we’ve got two new animals joining our development team! Squid will be helping us on the coding side and Kangaroo with the scriptwriting. 

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fzoo.png?alt=media[/img]

[h2]Alpha[/h2]
On April 8th, the alpha went out to Al-fire backers and above, and we’re very happy with their comments so far. Thank you so much for the feedback, bug reports, and streams. 🥰 We’ve categorized and prioritized all of it to fit it in our development cycle.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fstreams.gif?alt=media[/img]

The pre-order store is now closed, but we’ll continue to give alpha keys to the winners of our [url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord]Discord community [/url]minigame. Some members of the community are also doing their own giveaways with extra keys they’ve purchased.

[h2]The timeline[/h2]
In our previous devlog, we mentioned we would split the remaining work to match the dates of the alpha updates. 

Every month, we’ll share the status of our general project overview, as well as what we plan for the upcoming alpha update.

Our current broad strategy is to include a new season and region in each alpha iteration until we complete the in-game year and the whole map. At that point, the game will have a complete cycle, and the alpha will no longer “end” at a specific in-game date. Along with it, we’ll work on features and mechanics, new content, fix bugs, and make quality of life improvements. 

[h2]The next alpha iteration[/h2]
Kickstarter orders took a while to process, but we believe we’re still on track to deliver the next iteration in early June. This is a preview of what we’re working on:

[h3]Summer[/h3]
Days are getting longer in real life (in the northern hemisphere at least), so it was fitting that we worked on the next season of the game. This will allow alpha players to kick back and relax in the summer heat with new plants, animals, dialogues, and even a new event!

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fsummer.png?alt=media[/img]

Seasons affect almost everything in the game. For summer, we’re adjusting some systems and developing new ones. The good news is that all efforts made for this new season will make fall and winter easier to implement.

[h3]Savanna[/h3]
The other main feature we’re working on adding is the savanna which lies northwest of The Land Between Two Rivers. It’s a place of tall grasses, canyons, and shallow waters.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fsavanna.gif?alt=media[/img]

This geography is very special to the Clan. A long time ago, in a place similar to this, they learned to stand upright to walk on their two feet, and overlook the tall grass.

[h3]New Fauna & Flora[/h3]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fgualknaco.gif?alt=media[/img]
To accompany both the new season and the map expansion, we’re improving and adding new animations for some animals.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Fmilk.gif?alt=media[/img]
In the current alpha, the only animal that produced something was the female ostrich (guess what she drops... that’s right, an ostrich egg!). Now, you’ll obtain something from each of the current tameable animals. For some, you’ll need a new tool like a milk container to milk your ibexes.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F12%2Ftrees-2-rows.png?alt=media[/img]
We’ve redone the trees to match the style of the other assets better. We aimed for a more natural look. We’re also working on new plants that will spawn in the summer, like tall grasses and bushes.

[h3]New Event: Rites of passage 🌱[/h3]
The Clan celebrates rites when there’s an important event in the life of one of its members. One of those events is the passage to adulthood. 

Soon after the Clan settles in their promised land, the shaman decides it’s time for a “Rite of Passage.” And this one is very special, as it’s your time to make an offering and take the oath of caring for your Clan.

What would you offer your Clan, and how would you like to help?

Next devlog, we’ll show you the progress made on these features, along with other things planned for the next alpha update:

🍅 Split items in the inventory
🦙 Multiple animal sheds
🐮 Name animals 
🧀 Some new processors and items
🎶 Music for each area in spring and summer 
💬 More character dialogues 


Thank you for reading! If you’ve got any questions or just want to be part of a great community, we invite you to join our Discord!

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2FDiscord.png?alt=media[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #11: The after-party!
notes.content:
[h1]The Festival is over. Time for the after-party! 💃🕺[/h1]
Hello Clan!! We had such a blast at the Festival of Kickstarter. Thank you all for having fun with us, and for all your support and love. 💙

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FThank-You.gif?alt=media&token=b14ddb04-839b-456e-b74d-bd0cfe296ba3[/img]

[h2]Pre-order store[/h2]
But this party is not over yet! In case you missed the campaign or had trouble with Kickstarter payment methods, we’ve opened a pre-order store page where you can still get the digital rewards. It will only be open for the month of April and then we will need to end the party, have a bunch of mates 🧉 (the drink), and get back to work.

[url=https://roots-of-pacha.myshopify.com/]Go to the pre-order store[/url]
[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FStore.gif?alt=media&token=b83cb696-6961-4ee6-a0d3-8ab3d6073f42[/img]

[h2]The Pachan Cooking Contest[/h2]
Food, so much food 🤤🤤🤤. Our stomachs have been growling nonstop for the past month. Thanks to everyone who participated!

[h3]Raffle Winners[/h3]
🥁🥁🥁 Congratulations to @askjdniasucialsd, @batonga, @rollingstampede! You’re the 3 winners of the raffle and will be getting access to the alpha 🔥!

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FRaffleWinners.png?alt=media&token=e18804fd-b6a1-40cc-a491-d0ca49745e39[/img]

[h3]Main Prize Winners[/h3]
We’ll be choosing the 2 main prize winners in the next few days. You’ve made this really hard for us, your creativity, descriptions, and yumminess were exceptional!

[h2]What we’ve been up to [/h2]
While planning and running the Kickstarter campaign, we continued to build on the game even after letting streamers play.

[b]During this past month we’ve added:[/b]
[h3]Style & new decorations[/h3]
We added tall grasses that spawn in batches, 3 flooring types (dirt, wood, stone), worked on item alignment, and updated plant shadings. This is how the game looks now:

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FStyle.png?alt=media&token=fc09ef1f-5e7a-44fe-a4bc-29f29225eb9c[/img]

[h3]Food[/h3]
We’ve added the initial cooking mechanics with a few recipes you can make and their animations!

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FCooking.gif?alt=media&token=cc79bd34-6018-4682-931b-69c72312896d[/img]

To expand on the importance of food preservation, we’ve added fish drying and fermenting to the existing processors.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FDryingFish.png?alt=media&token=d2444034-f6c0-443b-9808-267dbada5c32[/img]

[h3]Multi contribution & Storage[/h3]
A much-requested feature by the content creators who played the pre-alpha, and something that was on our backlog, was the ability to contribute multiple items at once. You can now open a contribution menu to easily contribute after a good day of foraging and harvesting. You can even recover what’s been contributed for the day if you accidentally dropped it in.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FContributions.gif?alt=media&token=356afcbe-7682-4b31-a88c-e4a775f36352[/img]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FStorage.gif?alt=media&token=8a3a7aa6-14af-45e8-ac0a-120fea79548b[/img]

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
We’ve implemented an easy way to report bugs and feedback inside the game. Just pressing F1 will bring up a feedback menu. Alongside your description, we’ll receive a screenshot and state of the game to try to reproduce the issue.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FBugs.png?alt=media&token=c9a262c4-a26d-4a5e-a00c-e53dbb727f00[/img]

[h3]Cross-platform tests[/h3]
We received our Switch Dev kits last month and were able to play cross-platform! There are still many integrations, optimizations, and improved controller support to do. Still, it’s great that we develop for it early on!

If you want to read more about it, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sodaden/roots-of-pacha/posts/3122804]we made a post about it[/url]

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FSwitch.png?alt=media&token=d1781e8d-0bbe-4443-ae1a-624f3ac8d6c6[/img]

[h3]Load menu[/h3]
We’ve always had a save system, but loading was a bit tricky and not 100% functional. We’ve now implemented a basic but proper menu and also integrated it with Steam for identifying users in multiplayer.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FLoad.gif?alt=media&token=19ae9ca0-f03c-4eb2-8d55-a1fdebd296d2[/img]

[h2]What’s next[/h2]
This month we’ll split our time between coordination and development. 

[h3]Coordination[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ll be processing Kickstarter pledges and pre-order stores. We’re developing a simple tool to automate the process of assigning Discord roles and providing alpha backers with keys.
[*] Open up Discord channels for alphas.
[*] We’re working on an updated timeline that includes stretch-goals and assets from Kickstarter design tiers.
[*] We’re growing our team. It’s a gradual process as we want to have the right size to keep our current synergy.
[/list]

[h3]Development[/h3]
Our main priority this month is to deliver the updated alpha to backers and winners of contests, receive and categorize feedback and bugs.

We have a few things already going on, which we’re scheduled to finish this month:
[list]
[*] Sketch and try the dimensions of the updated map with new locations (Tundra and Turtle Islands).
[*] Seasons assets for The Land Between Two Rivers and Forest area.
[*] Work on the back story of the game, the Yakuans, and other roaming tribes.
[/list]

We’ll also start working on the features defined in this month’s planning sessions.

[img]https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/roots-of-pacha-production.appspot.com/o/devlogs%2F11%2FByeBye.gif?alt=media&token=4e3f630d-146e-4b79-8bd6-9e706fbd733d[/img]

Thank you once again for all your support!
