You can now open a contribution menu to easily contribute after a good day of foraging and harvesting.
You can even recover what’s been contributed for the day if you accidentally dropped it in.
We’ve implemented an easy way to report bugs and feedback inside the game.
Just pressing F1 will bring up a feedback menu.
Alongside your description, we’ll receive a screenshot and state of the game to try to reproduce the issue.
We received our Switch Dev kits last month and were able to play cross-platform!
We’ve always had a save system, but loading was a bit tricky and not 100% functional.
We’ve now implemented a basic but proper menu and also integrated it with Steam for identifying users in multiplayer.

notes.title: Devlog #8: 100% Whole Wheat
notes.content:
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eofb8m7e1dp6l5d1vj6pv56413.png[/img]

[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Connect[/h1]
We did our first livestream with Crytivo Connect showcasing the gameplay for the first time and explaining some of our core mechanics. Thanks everyone for joining and sharing your thoughts. If you haven’t watched it yet, it’s now on Youtube

[previewyoutube=5M-Lv4bmSDY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Racing tournament[/h1]
We felt we were missing some action, and we always wanted to include a sport or tournament inside the game to break the routine of planting and evolving. After some research we found that horse racing is one of the ancient sports and we immediately thought about how many rideable animals we have in Roots of Pacha.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkg1k8ali1g7a17dqiae1eqg13.gif[/img]

We really had a lot of fun racing our animals. There’s still some work to do, and some of our ideas include giving stats to mounts, improving mounts with friendship and special items, choosing a team and becoming the star rider of a season.

[h1]Pacha Hearth[/h1]
Pachans are very social and so they have a common building where they spend rainy days, gather for a warm meal and receive visitors. Vuak, the sha-man and spiritual leader of the clan, is the one in charge of welcoming people to this place. Here’s a preview of his room which is inside the building.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkhe9dbe296b1m2g1t8e1qor8l.gif[/img]

[h1]Forest minimap[/h1]
As we continue to develop the world of Roots of Pacha, we add minimap sections of it. This is how the forest minimap looks like.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkie668it1p4m9pn1s1f12aa8v.gif[/img]

We’re also exploring if the minimap is something you already have, or if you have to complete it as you discover new areas.

[h1]Food producers and preservation[/h1]
A few devlogs ago we talked about how important food preservation was in the stone age. The idea was not only to improve the shelf time of food but also its nutrition. 

For example, in the process of making bread, the natural yeast that is present in the grains not only make flour rise and produce a spongy bread, but they also make the nutrients of the grain available for the human body to absorb.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkip51122u1ljo11v3lp1l4a9h.gif[/img]

At that point in time, most processes were manual and we felt it was a good idea to represent that in the game. This is the case of the Mortar and Pestle that’s used to grind grains into flours and also to mix, and whisk.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkj6oc1hpk1r7e15a01q45a469m.gif[/img]

Once you’ve got flour, mix in a little bit of water and let the dough ferment for a few hours. The Fermenter is a processor in Roots of Pacha that lets the natural yeasts in grain, flours and fruits turn into other products.

As a side note, yes, we read your comments, and yes there will be booze making in Roots of Pacha. For better or for worse, alcohol is ingrained in human history.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkjhp3ssn102v1efk1q7s1mbk9r.gif[/img]

Finally, after getting fermented dough, you shape it and throw it in the Oven to get that nice loaf.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobmqivn12e76jg12slsge1vk0u.gif[/img]

Another producer that we didn’t get a chance to show in the stream is the Solar Dryer. It’s made out of a couple of poles with nets in between that use the power of the sun to dry fruits and vegetables. The Solar Dryer accepts multiple items at once.

[h1]Taming minigame[/h1]
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkkeppu03hagpscpnk1m7bb9.gif[/img]

After discovering the flute that lets you communicate with animals, you need to attune to them to increase friendship. Flute playing was too immediate and not very rewarding, so we are trying this minigame where friendship will increase depending on how you play the melody.

[h1]Fishing minigame[/h1]
Fishing the shallow waters was a bit simple too, and we had a minigame we didn’t like where you had to hit keys in a certain order.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/12/1/devlog-8-food-is-everything/o_1eobkl2kasd21gkjd1d1pov1thcd7.gif[/img]

In the new one we developed this month, you have to remain calm and focus on one specific fish. Keep following it as it moves across the water nearby, but don’t do it too fast, the ripples will make it go away. Once you’re confident enough and you can see it, take a chance to fish it!.


[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/085126f7644637c184e05a8abc01f6557a1d7e96.png[/img][/url]

That's it for this edition, thanks for reading. We hope to read your comments on Discord and see you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #6: The Clan
notes.content:
[h2]Life at the Land Between Two Rivers[/h2]
What did our ancestors do on an everyday basis? A lot of their time was probably spent gathering provisions in the warm seasons to be able to outlast the cold ones, making pottery and weaving baskets to hold their belongings, curing meats and fermenting grains. They also built basic structures and made the tools needed for survival. As social animals, they chatted, told stories, played music and danced.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejfkcsm6140o1vimef585sub3u.gif[/img]

In Roots of Pacha, each NPC excels at something, like Croll being the best at building. But all of them contribute to the everyday activities of the clan. You might find Gin, the Clan’s leader, training for a hunting expedition, or Jizu gathering plants in the forest for Ada, the healer, to use.

[h2]Lucky for you that’s what I like[/h2]
Oh the things we cherish and the ones we hate. We improved the gift system so that NPCs will show a different portrait depending on what you give them. And because one man's trash is another man's treasure, you’ll have to discover what they like and what they don’t.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdu8ri6lc2137n1lj8jfj1i7p18.gif[/img]

[h2]Buildings[/h2]
Building takes time and sometimes a village. That’s why when the Clan decides to build something, the schedule of some NPCs change while in construction. How about some paint for that Sundial?

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduangv19e05hm1ijb1e3k2mr1q.gif[/img]

[h2]Mini map[/h2]
To make the world more immersive, we’re trying an approach where every quest, idea or cutscene is initiated by an NPC or by a location. Spreading out the events feels more realistic, but sometimes it’s too hard to find an NPC you’re looking for, or you just want to know where your friends are.

We’re developing a minimap per region with indications of the whereabouts of the Clan and key points of interest.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1eje11mnk16eqnbslbk10t51ulcu.png[/img]

Wondering how on earth could someone know the locations of everyone?. You’ll have to develop an idea with Voda, the tracker, to use the eagles' help.

[h2]Food preservation[/h2]
Without proper refrigeration, the Clan needs ways to improve food nutrition and make preserves that can last longer. Some things need a few steps to be made but the ending result is always so satisfying and is a much valuable contribution to the Clan.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdud89p17dc15qjahl10ii5tm24.png[/img]

Now, if we could only make some butter to go with it...

[h2]The power of fire[/h2]
We’ve made improvements to the lights engine. Our goal is to add depth to some objects in the world. When you are walking through the forest, lights will illuminate the trees on top of you but not the bottom ones.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduer3j18b5177l182312n01i1k29.gif[/img]

In the darkness of the night and the deepness of the caves, you need to carry a torch to see further around you. 

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejduik685cv92n1d8j1rbebpu73.gif[/img]

[h2]New plants[/h2]
It all starts and ends with plants, right? If you’re in our Discord, you may have noticed our fascination for the natural world (if you’re not, join us).

We’ve changed the look of the plants when they’re in the wild, they’re usually smaller and not very nutritious. As you plant them and keep growing them, they’ll evolve into their improved versions with larger roots, fruits and seeds, brighter colors and nice scents (we’re working on how to propagate smell through the speakers, so far nothing).

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdujh51h4un4g14832dnoa78.png[/img]

We also thought plants looked a bit too far apart, and now they have a better sense of depth. 

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdul3vf1ej616411e2d8rk1s5a7d.gif[/img]

[h2]Baaaaaa[/h2]
So we have a mountain, and what animal likes mountains? Yep, goats. We researched the oldest domesticated goats and one of them is the Ibex. Without further ado:

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdup1db1meqsg31r46oiq10ucbb.gif[/img]

[h2]Under the water[/h2]
As we develop more locations, we’re adding fishing spots. Some of the new fish you’ll encounter at different times of days and throughout the seasons:

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdusrvf1f621h7r39ammigqc3.png[/img]

[h2]In-game emotes[/h2]
All that hard work is fine, but we needed a way to celebrate your first successful harvest with your friends.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/10/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-6/o_1ejdurqug4shv2a1tk57ke1274bl.gif[/img]

Dance is so ingrained in human history, it even appears in cave art. It’s used to perform ritual and religious ceremonies, as a way to connect with each other socially, and to entertain. Dance is important in Roots of Pacha too, and might even help you strengthen friendship with the Clan.

[h2]SFX[/h2]
As we polish the world, we continue to add more sound effects. Have you ever heard an Ostrich?
[url=https://soundcloud.com/user-224179023/sfx-animals-ostrich/s-Y9B2lLjJb8e]Ostrich - SFX[/url]

[h2]Discord[/h2]
We’ve added more emojis with NPCs expressions, an animated gif icon and a couple of new channels where we revere mother nature and prehistoric science.

Join us!
[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/9/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-5/o_1eh2dh9negb3usc1nt13751qo5u.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #4: I've got an Idea
notes.content:
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eegojdngnsa10k1df31kck2omu.png[/img]

Hello Pachans, in this 4th edition you'll learn more about your home, resources, trees, the importance of "ideas," and the mysterious caves that dot the landscape of Pacha.

Join us on Discord!
[url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/602ad5464277b5ce473d29b9f15256727ac6c918.png[/img]
[/url]

[h1]Your house[/h1]
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeif6g7i1kav1ovi4l914pe1v8o1i.png[/img]
When you reach The Land Between Two Rivers, you and your friends will first live with your adoptive parents, the elders Igrork and Maeri. But you’re a grown up now, and probably want to get your own place. With a few materials and the help of Croll, the builder, you’ll build your home wherever you want.
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeif7rrh1vn312244a1p139da1n.png[/img]
You won’t need a lot of space in the beginning but will probably want to expand it later on!

[h1]Ideas[/h1]
We started talking a little bit about ideas last month. They’re a core part of the evolution of the Clan. Our ability to imagine things, to try our ideas and push ourselves to new things that might seem impossible, is what sets us apart from the other Pacha creatures.
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeif9c6t4i31cngpkg14cg1u8c1s.gif[/img]
All Clan members have ideas that they’ll share with you at some point in time, when improving their friendship and trust, discovering new regions, or finding elements. An idea is not more than an image in someone's mind, they’ll tell you a little bit about it and show you a rough sketch of what they’re thinking. It’ll be your choice to use the Clan’s Knowledge to develop ideas in any order you want.

[h1]Trees[/h1]
They don’t move but are always there, growing and reaching to the sky. Trees are usually taken for granted when they give us so much: shadow to rest, wood to make tools and build, bark to heal our wounds, fruits for food and medicine.

We’ve added 3 trees that grow natively in The Land Between 2 Rivers:
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeifavv81morc4smsn13jis6821.gif[/img]

[h1]Craftables[/h1]
We worked on the placing system for the craftables in your farm. There are now wood fences and gates that can open/close automatically when you’re nearby. 

We also added a new small water well so you don’t have to go to the river everytime you need water for your crops.
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeife3f4gr31kj0105t1hjs1jch26.gif[/img]
Most craftables will have to be unlocked through an idea too, so you’ll have to decide which ideas you want to develop first!

[h1]Contribution[/h1]
Your contribution will mainly be the crops that you grow, the food that you make from them, and anything you can find throughout the world. 
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeifhjp8du89sch571unt1b5v30.gif[/img]
This large vessel holds the daily contribution. It seems bottomless, but someone from the Clan distributes its content every night.

[h1]Gathering[/h1]
Throughout the world you’ll find different items that will help the Clan survive and progress.
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeifq5m6s1nenr1bpc1ka6se935.gif[/img]
Maybe a mushroom for rituals, some datura flowers with strong healing powers, poop for the hunters to camouflage their scent, or oregano to make your favorite dishes (prehistoric pasta sauce?).

[h1]Social[/h1]
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeifrlnn178s18a911vdqpl18uk3a.png[/img]
We improved the dialogue UI, with a new layout, answers and style. As you talk with the Clan members, give them gifts and help them in their everyday tasks, you’ll develop friendship.
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeift11h11vqjk9d66fk975p3f.png[/img]
And what’s a friendship if not a plant that needs to be nurtured and cared for. That’s why we represent it as one. Start from seed and watch it convert into a beautiful flower.

[h1]Shed[/h1]
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeigkkttace1jj1u6a1p1617fru.gif[/img]
Following up with previous month’s animal love, we’ve started trying out the first shed you can invent, build and place in your farms. 

[h1]Caves[/h1]
[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/31/roots-of-pacha-devlog-4/o_1eeig2tq21510u3h1q9s2td14005a.png[/img]
You are walking next to a rock cliff, and suddenly see this entrance partly hidden with vegetation. An entrance to the inner depths of the world, where Pacha’s manifestations take real shape. 

Caves are places where you can find resources and encounter magical beings. To venture deeper there’ll be challenges, but rewards will be worth them. In following devlogs we’ll be revealing more about them.


Good for you if you made it this far, it’s been a pretty intense month with lots of stuff taking shape. See you next time!

notes.title: Devlog #3: Ride the Ostrich
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/575762906b2f3894aa52d10f8db283ac7326ba20.png[/img]

June brought us summer (or winter if you’re in the southern hemisphere), and with that came along new animals and their taming mechanic, improvements to the regions, and new ideas and buildings that can be discovered and built. 

[h1]Animals[/h1]
In Roots of Pacha, animals aren’t just simply bought. Being part of nature and children of Pacha, they live freely in herds and packs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/0ce89fdcb1a4a0909894815f1a7a7d30a92debcb.gif[/img]

Among the different regions, herds of several species of animals will appear in their natural habitat looking for food and shelter. Some of them won’t stay for long and will migrate during colder seasons to look for warmer spots, or during their mating season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/b97f4af10987081ff29f6191431d33a9b8aecc89.gif[/img]

Herds are families, there’s at least one mom and one dad, and then there are the babies. They’ll all age and new generations will take their places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/79594d7dd384c7f86a39c548bc432026b9c3e69b.gif[/img]

In the wilderness when trying to approach them, they get bothered by your presence. It’s their instinct to be scared of strangers. With the help of your clan, you’ll learn how to care for them and they’ll even take food from your hand. Just remember they might not like everything you want to give them. 


After gaining their trust, you might want to build a place for them to live with the Clan. By continuing caring for them, and discovering some tools, they’ll start rewarding you with valuable products. Others will let you ride them and take you places further and faster than you could have ever imagined.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-3/o_1ec39d5um1phc14pc13b2ao0o5518.gif[/img]

Going somewhere and wanting to take along a friend?. Some of the animals will be so happy with the Clan that they’ll take as many as they can fit. 

Our work with animals is not done yet. Some of our ideas for next round are: different colors for animals of the same species that will change from season to season, and breeding when a male and female of the same species live with the Clan.


       [url=https://rootsofpacha.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/602ad5464277b5ce473d29b9f15256727ac6c918.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Ideas & Buildings[/h1]

Living in the stone age means a lot of what we take for granted today wasn’t invented. Part of your task, if you choose to, is to talk and discuss ideas with the people of your Clan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/db72f42be0715a6ca0c837808da4ee465d67b7e9.gif[/img]

By domesticating plants and improving their quality, taming new animals and getting to know them, and simply by exploring the world, the Clan will gain knowledge. It’ll be your choice to spend the knowledge however you want to develop an idea. 

New ideas will start popping up here and there, when you mine a new type of rock, discover an unknown plant, or spot a different kind of animal. Some ideas come from people not in your clan but will only be revealed when you get to know them.

[img]https://www.crytivo.com/img/pages/2020/7/1/roots-of-pacha-devlog-3/o_1ec3tjm0j147tjqc1nj316hql621c.gif[/img]

As part of evolving the Clan, you’ll gather materials and construct buildings. What you build and where you place the building, will affect the schedule of the Clan members.


[h1]Spring OST[/h1]
This past month we added more sound effects to player actions, footsteps that change according to terrain, and music loops for different seasons. This is a preview of one of the spring loops.

[url=https://soundcloud.com/user-224179023/spring-the-land-between-two-rivers]Spring - The land between two rivers[/url]



On July, we'll be working on revamping parts of the UI, the objects placement system, animals sheds, decoration, player customization and balance. 

That's it for now, thanks for reading and let us know how we're doing and what you'd like to see next.

notes.title: Devlog #2: Promised Land
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/de2fbf834304e0ac272a99dee0be5e432241ae54.png[/img]

In this edition dear Pachan, we’d like to introduce you to the start of the game and some of its mechanics.

[h2]The story of humanity[/h2]
The creation of our world starts with Pacha, our goddess, mother of everything.

She lived peacefully, neither in light nor in darkness, for she is both. One day, she decided to start filling the canvas of the universe. She exhaled and from her breath came the dust that formed the stars and our world. She wept, and her tears filled the rivers and the oceans. She raised her hands and with that trees and plants reached for the sky. From her womb came all the animals that now roam the earth. Even after being exhausted from all the effort, she pushed once again and we, humans, emerged.

For generations and generations, we honored and lived by her. We split in small groups, staying in places just enough to fulfill our needs before moving somewhere else. Our life didn’t change much, we were used to that way of living. Although we had periods of hardships, we felt comfortable.

But Pacha had a purpose for us, a prophecy as old as this story.

[h2]Start of the journey[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/4637501769ec4f6fb38d2be135ebad867f634219.png[/img]
One of the things we’ve worked on this month has been the introduction to the game. Here you’ll learn about the prophecy and the purpose Pacha has for us. After a shaking event, a search party goes out to find a new land where we are to live our new life.

[h2]Plant Discovery[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/4596d3163b9eaf6551abe7c80dccf64c69877630.gif[/img]
With no labs or microscopes, our only way as humans to find out if we could eat something was to try it. What does it taste like? Does it feel weird in my tongue? Is it similar to something else I know? Is my mom yelling at me: “Don’t put that in your mouth! It’s poisonous!!”?. Hints, trial and error, and instinct were the only tools we had.

In Roots of Pacha, to find a new plant that can be domesticated and later grown by the Clan you first have to explore the world and try to find a wild version of it. If you try the fruit and it’s good, you can keep its seeds and try growing them.

[h2]Water from the skies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605738/142ee059752b09a6724117aacc76fa3e4dfcf5f1.gif[/img]
Rain is a blessing from Pacha, and the Clan spends a lot of time making rituals to call for it. It deserved that we put some love into how it looks in the world. So we decided to implement ripples in the water when it’s raining.


Help us spread the love for farming and our own history (or a version of it)!
